title: GY-302 (BH1750FVI) low-cost light sensor: calibration dataset and analysis code
description:
Complete paired dataset (26 calibration pairs and 22 independent validation pairs) comparing a low-cost GY-302 (Rohm BH1750FVI) digital light sensor with an ITR-3000 reference luxmeter in the 1–45 lx range used in broiler-house lighting programmes, together with the Python code that reproduces the calibration equation and computes direct-error agreement metrics (bias, MAE, RMSE, maximum error, Bland–Altman limits of agreement, leave-one-out cross-validation) and a GUM-style uncertainty budget. It also includes an excerpt of the Arduino firmware that implements the correction.

The data were collected during the master's research of J. A. Carvalho Neto (FCA/Unesp, 2021) and support the article 'Laboratory Calibration and Agreement Assessment of a Low-Cost Digital Light Sensor (GY-302/BH1750FVI) for Broiler House Illuminance Monitoring' (Journal of Sensors).

Data: CC BY 4.0. Code: MIT.
